artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: New module, source only; nothing deploys. The principal_profile record (POLICY#<tid>#<oid> / principal_profile: profile_kind restricted, status pending|active|revoked, revision, grant_revision) and the versioned data_entitlement record (data_entitlement#<revision, 10 digits>: status, scope of masters, datasets, accounts per master, dates fixed_dates|rolling_complete_window, columns per dataset, operations), through app/access_state.py. It also carries: strict parsing (malformed denies); the tool classification (35 native + 9 integration legacy, the contract's 5 Schwab); the guard functions tool_denial / visible_tools / route_denial, each deciding from a strong read of the request principal's profile and grant; the per-dimension check_scope / authorize; and the operator record builders (optimistic revision condition, grant revisions written once).

Source only. `mcp` is now _PolicyGuardedMCP, a FastMCP subclass. Its list_tools filters discovery through data_entitlement.visible_tools, and its call_tool denies through data_entitlement.tool_denial before the tool function runs; both do the store read off the event loop with the principal passed explicitly. _run checks data_entitlement.tool_denial after the identity and tier resolution, before identity_scope, the guard and any token fetch. The 35 tool functions are unchanged.
Source only. run_integration_tool checks data_entitlement.tool_denial before identity_scope, min_tier and the credential provider, and returns the denial with its integration id.
Source only. register_enabled reports the tools data_entitlement.py does not classify (report[id]['unclassified']), which the guard hides and denies until they are classified.

Source only. _entitlement_block runs on /teams/poll and /query/v0 after bearer validation and the blocklist, before token_broker.get_token or query_v0.handle: 403 for a restricted profile, 503 for an unreadable store, None for a principal with no profile. /query/v0 marks its allowed check for the request so handle() does not read again. No route added or changed (29 declarations; OGZ1-AC14).

Source only. handle() checks data_entitlement.route_denial first, ahead of the rate limit, the email-domain internality (_principal), the catalog gate and the S3 fetch. OGZ1-AC9 calls it directly with a restricted principal: 403.

test_ogz1_ac01 .. test_ogz1_ac12, offline. It imports test_principal_cutover's harness helpers (local issuer, fake MSAL client, moto) and starts its own module-scoped app lifespan.
